anomalies.description: The explosion appears to originate from a vehicle (likely the white vehicle visible at 14.0s) on the road, resulting in its immediate destruction; debris and fire confirm a catastrophic vehicle impact or detonation.
A large, sudden explosion occurs on the road ahead, producing a bright fireball and a rapidly rising column of black smoke; debris is visible being ejected upward.
A large explosion occurs ahead on the road, producing a massive plume of dark smoke and a dust cloud that expands and drifts downwind over several seconds.

A vehicle appears to be involved in a violent impact or detonation on the left roadside, evidenced by the sudden massive dust cloud and smoke at t=20.0s, followed by rapid dispersion and settling over the next second; no intact vehicle is visible post-impact, suggesting catastrophic damage.

A large plume of dark smoke and dust erupts abruptly on the left side of the road, consistent with a near-instantaneous blast event; the smoke column is densest and most vertically developed in f0 (20.0s) and begins to expand laterally by f1 (20.5s).
